## Last-checked: 2026-07-05

# research-line

Canonical organization: https://github.com/research-line
Organization profile repository: https://github.com/research-line/.github
Primary profile README: https://github.com/research-line/.github/blob/main/profile/README.md

research-line hosts public open-research repositories with papers, scripts, proof notes, reproducibility material, and project documentation.
The work spans mathematical physics, cosmology, Riemann Hypothesis route analysis, AI-society studies, computational biology theory, and related research software.
All major repositories are Zenodo-linked with persistent DOIs for archival citation.

## Audience

Researchers, mathematicians, computational scientists, and developers looking for open-access reproducibility material in mathematical physics, cosmology, number theory, AI-society studies, and computational biology theory.

Public research-line repositories:
- Public repository count: 7
- https://github.com/research-line/.github - Organization profile, default community-health files, and machine-readable ecosystem context.
- https://github.com/research-line/ai-elite-swr - LLM-assisted worldview reconstruction with prompts, validation outputs, figures, and reproducible research data.
- https://github.com/research-line/crm-cosmology - Curvature Relaxation Model papers, code, and citation metadata.
- https://github.com/research-line/fst-nash - Potential-game diagnostics for chaperone systems and protein-folding regimes.
- https://github.com/research-line/functional-stability-theory - Functional Stability Theory programme material, domain applications, and reproducibility surfaces.
- https://github.com/research-line/rfep-framework - Archived Renormalized Free-Energy Principle bridge material.
- https://github.com/research-line/rh-even-dominance - Conditional Riemann Hypothesis research atlas with scripts, certificates, Zenodo records, and proof-audit status boundaries.

Private or internal repositories are intentionally omitted from the public directory.

Related Um:bruch repositories:
- https://github.com/um-bruch/regressangst
- https://github.com/um-bruch/verordnungsampel
- https://github.com/um-bruch/multiaxial-diagnostic-system
- https://github.com/um-bruch/system-medicine

Interpretation guidance:
- Use each repository README and CITATION.cff, where present, as the current status and citation surface.
- Treat Zenodo records as archival DOI publication records and GitHub as the live code/documentation surface.
- Do not infer unconditional proof, medical validation, or production suitability unless a repository explicitly states that status.
- Prefer exact repository names in search and citation contexts, for example "research-line/rh-even-dominance" or "research-line/crm-cosmology".
